title: A file the agent links in the chat by a path relative to the conversation folder downloads from the side panel; a relative path out of the folder is still refused
steps: S1: run vendor/tracy/dsh-better-sidebar tests/file-download.spec.ts with vitest: /sidebar/file?…&path=template.zip&download=1 for a session whose folder holds template.zip; then path=../secret.zip; plus the download-cap and saveDownload cases of -tracy.92.
expect: S1: the relative path answers 200 with the file's bytes; ../secret.zip answers 403 forbidden; every case of the file passes.
evidence: cowork.tracy.site 23/10/2026: the agent's link tracy_business-template.zip opened the side panel's Download pane; /sidebar/file answered 400 {"code":"fs-error","message":"\"tracy_business-template.zip\" is not an absolute path"} (beta bug B6, the file.json download).
fence: a relative path is joined onto the session cwd and then passes the same ensureWorkspacePath fence as an absolute one
